statements.impact_statement: The reviewed Keycloak runtime contains mssql-jdbc-13.2.1.jre11.jar, the fixed build. Trivy normalizes its package version to 13.2.1.

statements.status_notes: Guava 33.5.0 is present, and Keycloak 26.8.1 still ships an affected Guava. This rests on a review of the deployment and of Keycloak's own classes, not a proof across every library. Review when the Keycloak distribution, realm, proxy, or Compose networks change.
statements.impact_statement: The advisory needs Java native deserialization of an attacker-supplied Guava collection. The reviewed realm has no Kerberos federation or identity providers, which are the Keycloak features that read Java-serialized request data, and Keycloak is reachable only through the proxy on internal Compose networks.
